overview_description.description:
Pyn is a human resources company that improves employee communications using marketing techniques, such as personalization, scheduling, and automated triggering. It specializes in the fields of employee engagement, human, employment, and training. 

Pyn improves employee communications using marketing techniques such as personalization, scheduling, and automated triggering.

Pyn’s employee-centric communication tool cuts through the clutter of messages in order to send only relevant and well-timed messages at key moments.

It was founded in 2019 and headquartered in Sydney, New South Wales.

about_short_description.short_description: Pyn is a human resources company that helps companies to stay more engaged with their employees.

product.name: Employee Relationship Management (ERM)
product.description: A platform that automates and personalizes employee communications and workflows at key moments throughout the employee lifecycle to support HR functions and employee engagement.

product.name: Employee Journey Mapping
product.description: A tool to design and visualize the employee journey, identifying key moments to guide communications and HR interventions throughout the employee lifecycle.

product.name: Automated HR Communications and Workflows
product.description: Automation of HR communications and workflows triggered by employee lifecycle events, integrating with HRIS and messaging platforms to deliver timely, personalized messages.

product.name: Company Internal Communications Management
product.description: A platform to plan, execute, and measure internal company communications campaigns with targeting, personalization, and multi-channel delivery.

product.name: Sales & Support Performance Enablement
product.description: A solution to onboard and support sales and support teams with timely resources, coaching nudges, and performance data integration to improve ramp-up and ongoing performance.
